event_source.estimator_boundary: events plus fixed pinhole calibration only; no GT pose, target mask, depth, or future state
event_source.estimator_status: causal spatial learned event-state development model; status validity is event-count/time-bin based and does not imply localization accuracy

state_freshness_policy.no_event: return no usable state and hold current lateral command
state_freshness_policy.tracking_lost: return no usable state and hold current lateral command
state_freshness_policy.stale: return no usable state and hold current lateral command
state_freshness_policy.closure: do not initiate without a fresh state; if already started, keep fingers closed
state_freshness_policy.lift_gate: requires a fresh state at the last high-level control update

controller_estimator.input_contract: causal five 5ms bins, two polarities, 64x64, log1p counts; output state at cutoff
controller_estimator.causal_timestamp: five-bin input cutoff; events satisfy t < cutoff; output state is timestamped at cutoff

validity_policy.invalid_state_behavior: no_event/tracking_lost/stale returns no state and the existing controller holds lateral command and does not start closure

voxel_convergence.status: paired 1/2 kHz voxels made from the same 0.5 ms physical/HDR trajectory

post_contact_controller_state_boundary: event-derived target state is logged for evaluator diagnostics; the shared grip candidate gate uses finger joint position/velocity and close-command time, then the shared causal lift-probe monitor uses finger joint drift/velocity and probe-command time; evaluator GT does not enter either control gate

dynamic_visibility_evaluator_only.method: live robot segmentation divided by target-only segmentation at matching GT pose; evaluator-only
